duplicate_opaque:
def duplicate_opaque
  {E : Type _} (OpaqueEntropyInst : OpaqueEntropy E) :
  Result (Std.U8 × Std.U8)
  := do
  let first ← OpaqueEntropyInst.sample
  ok (first, first)
extractor: patched extractor, ordinary mode (both passes enabled)
unused_opaque:
def unused_opaque
  {E : Type _} (OpaqueEntropyInst : OpaqueEntropy E) : Result Std.U8 := do
  OpaqueEntropyInst.sample
